Convert a MultiAssayExperiment into a metime_analyser

get_convert_from_mae.Rd

This is a convenience wrapper around get_convert_from_se that converts a MultiAssayExperiment (MAE) into a metime_analyser. Each experiment in the MAE is first converted into a SummarizedExperiment and then combined into a single metime_analyser with one dataset per experiment. If dataset names are not provided, the names of the experiments are used.

Usage

get_convert_from_mae(mae, name = NULL, annotations_index = list())

Arguments

mae

A MultiAssayExperiment object.

name

Optional character vector of dataset names corresponding to the experiments within the MAE. If NULL, the experiment names will be used.

annotations_index

A named list specifying phenotype and medication datasets, passed through to the underlying conversion routines.

Value

A metime_analyser object containing one dataset per experiment in the input MAE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  mae <- get_convert_to_mae(humet_object)
  analyser <- get_convert_from_mae(mae)
} # }
